channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anthony Davis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anthony Davis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis heading into the season without a contract extension:

“AD's in a great frame of mind, focused and ready to start the season… I expect AD to remind the basketball world who he is.”

Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on LeBron James, Anthony Davis
item.description:
?Legion Hoops: Lionel Hollins on why LeBron James and Anthony Davis rarely worked out together:

“LeBron told him ‘you’ve got to get up a little earlier to come work out with me.’”

Lionel Hollins on LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Aug 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa:

“The Wizards haven't been to the playoffs in some time, so I just want to make the playoffs year one. I think we have the team to do it, getting Anthony Davis, getting Trae Young and having our young core. But ultimate goal is I'll start getting D-Wade, I always wanted to be a Hall of Famer, but he says the goal I should have is to be a top 100 player. So I think 20 years from now, I answer the league 20 years from now, it will be the 100-year anniversary of the NBA. And you know, like top 75, they bring the 75 best players, I always says when they bring the 100 players out, that should be my goal instead of just being a Hall of Famer.”

AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young, Jun 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Michael Winger on Brian Keefe, Anthony Davis, Alex Sarr
item.description:
Wizards Film Room:Winger on who will play center between Sarr and AD:

“I would imagine Alex. I would also submit that AD is a special talent and AD is a special guy and if AD says I need a break from the ‘5’ for a few minutes,BK [Brian Keefe] is going to give him a break from the ‘5’ for a few minutes so we will listen to Anthony. He has a very loud vote in what happens on the court.”

Michael Winger on Brian Keefe, Anthony Davis, Alex Sarr, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on how the Luka Doncic trade went down:

“Dallas wanted Anthony Davis and he was on our team. Conversations started but it was important they remained private….Those conversations started in the beginning of January…Rob Pelinka was able to pull it off all without it leaking to the media because I think Mark Cuban would’ve jumped in front of a train to keep it from happening. Nobody knew including Luka, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James. We had a game in New York that night, the coach knew this was going to happen but he still had to coach the game. It wasn’t a distraction”

Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss:

“[Redick] handles pressure really well. As a former NBA player, playing for Duke University, he's been through a lot and he brings that steadiness, that calmness, that desire to execute, the obsession about basketball. Last year we had a major trade when Anthony Davis left and Luka Doncic joined us, and he didn't miss a beat. He was able to reconfigure and get into a new direction, and I think a lot of rookie head coaches might have been thrown off a lot by that. But instead, JJ rose to the challenge and he continues to do that.”

Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Apr 20, 2026. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis
item.description:
“… So you add a player like (Davis) at the rim, in pick-and-roll and (in a) two-man game, that opens it up. But again, (having) Anthony Davis (and) surrounding him with the level of shooters that we have … I think the floor is going to be spread. We’re going to have a lot of people who can make decisions, and that’s how we want to play basketball. So it won’t be one person dominating the ball, and that’s not what we want. So again, adding these guys positionally made a lot of sense.”

Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis, Feb 8, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Dawkins was also asked how he envisions Trae Young and Anthony Davis meshing with each other.

“Trae probably has never played with a player to the level of Anthony Davis, while also leading the league in assists and assist percentage,”

Will Dawkins on Anthony Davis, Feb 8, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Matt Riccardi on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Matt Riccardi on why now was the right time to trade Anthony Davis:

“We evaluated everything…The deal we got hits certain threshold of what we wanted to do and how we wanted to move forward. It provided that flexibility & that optionally & it gave us the opportunity to build the team in a certain type of way.”

Matt Riccardi on Anthony Davis, Feb 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Jason Kidd on the challenge of replacing the prodciuton lost from Anthony Davis' latest injury:

“We're not looking to replace AD. It's got to be a group effort – the next man up. We'll miss AD while he is out, but we've had injuries this season, so this isn't something new.”

Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis, Jan 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Jason Kidd on losing Davis, Williams:

“I don't think it's tough. I think that's our norm with injuries or sickness. We lose guys. Next guy up. I thought Ryan did a good job for us. Caleb did a good job. Klay did a great job in his 900th game. He came off the bench & gave us a spark.”

Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis, Jan 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis’ return:

“We always want him to play. … We’ll see the 30-34 minutes he’ll be able to play.”

Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis, Dec 31, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Jason Kidd on the plan for Anthony Davis:

“Hopefully it’s not long. He’s going better, but we’ll see here in the next couple days of how long he’ll be out.”

Jason Kidd on Anthony Davis, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Max Christie on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Max Christie on Anthony Davis' looming return:

“It'll be great. Someone of his caliber coming back in the lineup is big for us, especially with our offensive struggles. You add someone like that who can only help. I'm looking forward to having him back & working him back into our gameplan. It'll be fun.”

Max Christie on Anthony Davis, Nov 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Bontemps said around the 33:00 mark.

“I shouldn't say it's not gonna happen... but, you talk to people in the league, there's not a lot of teams that are lining up to take on a 35-year-old Anthony Davis making $63 million, and you have to assume that he's gonna opt into that deal.”

Tim Bontemps on Anthony Davis, Nov 24, 2025. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Anthony Davis
item.description:
During Monday's episode of The Hoop Collective, ESPN's Tim Bontemps explained that Davis' trade value isn't as high as many would expect for a player of his caliber.

“The idea of trading Anthony Davis has everyone trained to think, well, they're gonna get three firsts, two swaps, they're gonna get two young players and they're gonna get all this stuff,”

Tim Bontemps on Anthony Davis, Nov 24, 2025. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison
item.description:
“Then he had the bad luck of Anthony Davis never being available basically. “Butthe thing that bothers me is he’s just being made a scapegoat. Listen, Shaq knows this, Kenny knows this, there’s no way in the world Nico Harrison had the power to trade Luka Doncic unless the owner of the team signed off on it. That was his call, so I feel bad the way Nico’s being made a scapegoat.”

Charles Barkley on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Nico Harrison, Nov 14, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Anthony Davis
item.description:
“We wanted a two-way player to lead our team and that was Anthony Davis. And so everybody's going to have their critics and I'm not sure what Mark said, but that's a better question left for him. But we got what we wanted.”

Nico Harrison on Anthony Davis, Apr 15, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JJ Redick on Anthony Davis
item.description:
JJ Redick on Anthony Davis:

“I’m forever grateful to AD for our relationship as player-coach, and his allowing a guy that’s never coached outside of 9-and 10-year-olds to coach him … We had a terrific relationship. He was a pleasure to be around every day.”

JJ Redick on Anthony Davis, Apr 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Dirk Nowitzki:

“Anthony Davis probably came back too soon and then got injured again. That meant Kyrie had to carry a huge load over the past few weeks, playing a lot of minutes, and then—he tore his ACL. It’s just a really strange situation. Lively has also been out for a long time. It just feels like this season is cursed. It’s tough, really tough. And now, honestly, I don’t know what’s next for them—either for the rest of this season or even next year. But this is just the new reality for Mavs fans. It’ll take a while to get over it, but we’ll see how things develop.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Anthony Davis, Mar 17, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Jeanie Buss:

“You know, in my position, there are certain players in the league that you think, 'There's no way I'll ever have that player on my team.' It’s just impossible—unless you draft a star like that, they usually don't move. When the opportunity came up, we were not looking to move Anthony Davis. He was our rock-solid player, and we had to give up a lot to get Luka. I look back, and I remember the last time I saw Kobe alive—about a month before he passed. He had brought Gigi to a Lakers game to see Luka play because Luka was Gigi's favorite player. The idea that Luka is now a Laker—I know how happy that would have made Kobe and Gigi.”

Jeanie Buss on Anthony Davis, Feb 26, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JJ Redick on Anthony Davis
item.description:
“He's a fantastic human being, wonderful teammate… For a guy who is a superstar, been in the Olympics, won the Finals, been All-NBA, (Davis) probably had a decent amount of skepticism with a coach who has never coached before. Former podcaster if you will. For him to just accept me and be open to a relationship… Was big time. Speaks a lot to who he is as a person… Certainly miss him as a player… He's just a pleasure to be around.”

JJ Redick on Anthony Davis, Feb 26, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Max Christie on Anthony Davis
item.description:
Max Christie on Anthony Davis' performance before his departure:

“I'm used to seeing that. You guys can expect to see that every night.”

Max Christie on Anthony Davis, Feb 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic
item.description:
to see Lakers trade former teammate Anthony Davis for Luka Doncic: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on his reaction to the Luka Doncic-Anthony Davis trade:

“I was very shocked. I was very shocked. Because I thought, in my mind, in my opinion, I thought Luka was going to be like the next Dirk [Nowitzki] as far as like spending 20 years in Dallas. I thought LA would never get rid of AD. So, I was shocked that it happened. I'm excited for both teams, both groups, both guys. I talked to AD last night and congratulated him. I feel like he's excited, when we were texting. I'm looking forward to just seeing how that works out.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Anthony Davis, Luka Doncic, Feb 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Al Horford on Kyrie Irving, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“I really don’t understand it. I think we’re all kind of looking for those answers right now. And I just think time will tell. Obviously, Anthony Davis is probably having one of the better seasons that he’s had in many years, and they have their guy in Kyrie (Irving) that can kind of run the show for them. So it will be interesting to see obviously how it plays out from both sides.”

Al Horford on Kyrie Irving, Anthony Davis, Feb 2, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: LeBron James on Anthony Davis
item.description:
James said when asked if the short break healed his foot.

“It’s an everyday thing. It’s been lingering for the last few years, but I was able to do a lot of great things to reassure not only that, but I got kneed in the quad in the Atlanta game at the end of regulation by (Anthony Davis), that’s now back to 100 percent. Probably three days ago it was still pretty sore. But I’m able to get that back to 100 (percent), so that was great, so I was able to hit a lot of other elements as well.”

LeBron James on Anthony Davis, Dec 16, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: JJ Redick on LeBron James, Anthony Davis
item.description:
JJ Redick:

“We're going to empower him (Anthony Davis) as much as he wants to be empowered. I mean, if he wants to be first-team All-NBA and he wants to be in the MVP conversation all year long, we're going to empower him to do that. Same goes for LeBron—we’ll give him the freedom to be a playmaker and scorer, but within a system that allows other guys to thrive too. It’s about maximizing these players within a structure.”

JJ Redick on LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Sep 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Sarr:

“I studied the whole league, really. I just see how different guys are. There are a lot of different great shot blockers. I’ve looked at AD(Anthony Davis), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Rudy Gobert clips. For me, it’s more a matter of instincts and knowing when to go for the ball and knowing when not to go.”

Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 16, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: LeBron James on Anthony Davis
item.description:
After going scoreless in Game 3 on 0-for-7 shooting (0-for-6 from 3), he declined to speak to reporters after the game, according to a team spokesperson.

“We've been -- me and this guy [Davis] have been playing together for six years,”

LeBron James on Anthony Davis, Apr 26, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jamal Crawford on LeBron James, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“They don't have enough to even compete right now. And my thing is, if LeBron [James] is still your best player at this point, I’m looking at trading Anthony Davis.”

Jamal Crawford on LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Mar 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.
